faqExtras.q: Does Cathay publish an award chart?
faqExtras.a: Yes, distance-based. Long-haul business, Hong Kong to London or the US West Coast, is 88,000 miles one way on the current chart, with separate charts for partner awards and a oneworld multi-carrier chart for trips on several airlines. Find your award's band, then price the exact shortfall with the calculator above.

faqExtras.q: Do Asia Miles expire?
faqExtras.a: Only with total inactivity: the balance lapses 18 months after your last earn or redemption, and any single transaction resets all of it for another 18. An account that books an award after topping up is safe by construction.

faqExtras.q: Can I upgrade a Cathay Pacific flight with miles?
faqExtras.a: Yes, one cabin up, from eligible fare classes; the cheapest economy buckets and most non-Cathay-operated flights are excluded. Check your ticket's fare class first, then buy the miles the upgrade needs.

faqExtras.q: What is Asia Miles now?
faqExtras.a: The mileage currency of Cathay, the programme that replaced the Marco Polo Club and standalone Asia Miles in 2022. Your miles live in your Cathay membership account and work like any major program's; this page's rate, limits and delivery window all refer to it.

quirks.title: Surcharges depend on whose metal you book
quirks.text: Cathay's own award flights carry meaningful carrier surcharges, around $200 per long-haul segment, while the same miles on partners like Finnair and Qantas price without them.

quirks.title: One programme, two old names
quirks.text: Marco Polo Club and Asia Miles merged into 'Cathay' in 2022; Asia Miles survives as the currency, so older guides describe the same account under different names.

quirks.title: The multi-carrier chart is a quiet weapon
quirks.text: A separate cumulative-distance chart prices trips on two or more oneworld carriers, with stopovers and open jaws allowed; it usually takes manual distance math and a phone call.

faqExtras.q: Do Qantas Points expire?
faqExtras.a: Yes — after 18 months without earning or redeeming on the account. Any eligible activity resets the clock, and Qantas warns by email at 12 months dormant and again 45 days out, so a topped-up balance should be booked inside that window.

faqExtras.q: What can I book with Qantas Points?
faqExtras.a: Classic Rewards are the value play: fixed points prices on Qantas, Jetstar, Oneworld carriers and partners including Emirates. Classic Plus opens far more seats but follows the cash fare and only covers Qantas' own flights, so the per-point value is much lower.

faqExtras.q: Are there fees on Qantas award bookings?
faqExtras.a: Yes. Carrier charges apply on top of the points price and are heaviest on Qantas' own long-haul premium cabins; partner bookings often carry lower charges. The taxes and charges are shown before you confirm the booking.
